name: Kiyohara no Motosuke
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 42); Porter’s note gives the dates as: late 10th century.

poems.title: Our sleeves, all wet with tears, attest
poems.author: Kiyohara no Motosuke
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 42
poems.text:
Our sleeves, all wet with tears, attest
That you and I agree
That to each other we’ll be true,
Till Pine-tree Hill shall be
Sunk far beneath the sea.

poems.title: 42. 契りきな かたみに袖を しぼりつつ (Chigirikina katami ni sode o shiboritsutsu)
poems.author: Kiyohara no Motosuke
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 後拾遺集
poems.text:
契りきな かたみに袖を しぼりつつ
末の松山 浪こさじとは
